blocks.text: The Sexbomb Girls returned to the “Eat Bulaga” stage on Saturday, Sept. 19, with leader Rochelle Pangilinan making a surprise appearance after the group initially performed without her. During the episode, Vic Sotto teased that the girl group would perform its latest single, prompting Allan K to ask whether the members would be complete and if Pangilinan would be joining them. Jose Manalo jokingly said Pangilinan would not make it, while Allan K insisted that she might still appear. “Mas masaya talaga kapag nandito siya, pero hindi dadating,” Manalo said.
